newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed on Monday with most traders sidelined due mainly to the absence of fresh incentives, dealers said.

"Rates were a little bit mixed in the morning on some position adjustments. There's no fresh news or (U.S.) economic indicators coming out later tonight and most people are sitting on the sidelines," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Tuesday's issue of the consumer price index and housing starts figures for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday rose 1/8 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed rose 1/16 point each to a common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.
Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
Three-months eased 1/16 point to 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent, nine-months eased 1/16 point to 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months eased to 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
